title: A Threshold Model of Fault Propagation in AI-Native Software Ecosystems
abstract: arXiv:2604.19827v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When many coding agents work in one repository at once, software engineers are left to judge a collective through its parts. Review examines one change at a time, yet a change can incorporate a fault introduced by another, and repairing the originating change then no longer repairs the repository. To keep human judgment at the centre of agentic software development, we need models of what agents do together. This paper joins complexity theory with software evolution to build one. We model how a fault spreads among open changes as a branching process over contention, the relation between two changes that are open at the same time and modify a common file. As with the reproduction number of an epidemic, spread sustains itself once each faulty change passes the fault, on average, to more than one other. Each repository has a reference threshold, the crossing probability per contention link above which spread would sustain itself i

translated_title: AI原生软件生态系统中故障传播的阈值模型
translated_abstract: 当许多编码智能体同时在同一个代码仓库中工作时，软件工程师只能通过各个部分来评判一个集体。代码审查一次只检查一个变更，然而一个变更可能引入了由另一个变更带来的缺陷，此时即使修复了原始变更，也无法再修复整个仓库。为了让人类判断保持在智能体软件开发的核心位置，我们需要刻画智能体集体行为的模型。本文将复杂性理论与软件演化相结合来构建这样的模型。我们将缺陷在开放变更之间的传播建模为一个基于“争用”的分支过程——争用指两个同时开放的变更修改同一文件之间的关系。正如流行病学中的再生数一样，一旦每个有缺陷的变更平均将缺陷传递给超过一个其他变更，传播就会自我维持。每个仓库都存在一个参考阈值，即每个争用链接上的交叉概率，一旦超过该阈值，传播就会自我维持。
tldr: 本文将复杂性理论与软件演化相结合，把AI编码智能体引入的缺陷在开放变更间的传播建模为基于争用关系的分支过程，并证明每个仓库存在一个使故障传播自我维持的临界阈值。
en_tdlr: This paper combines complexity theory with software evolution to model fault propagation among open changes by AI coding agents as a branching process over contention, revealing that each repository has a critical threshold above which fault spread sustains itself.
